assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: NeuxAlly avatar production static body texture, transparent square PNG; animated eyes are drawn separately by code.
Input image 1 is the exact body geometry and neutral pose reference. Transform its body material into a friendly round sci-fi MECHA ROBOT while preserving the same full rounded bell/teardrop silhouette, domed top, broad soft belly, two short drooping side arms and two tiny rounded feet. Front-facing, centered, same scale and framing, entire character visible. The machine itself has this shape; it is not a creature wearing a suit.
Material/design: a compact toy-like mechanical body with a few broad curved armor plates of matte cool light gray coated alloy, dark slate navy recessed structural joints, subtly beveled panel edges and a small number of restrained cyan-blue illuminated seams. Approximately 65% cool light gray, 30% slate navy, 5% cyan accents. Rich three-dimensional hard-surface volume, soft studio highlights, gentle brushed-metal detail and very few integrated fasteners. Larger panel structure must remain legible at 40–96px avatar size. Use restrained structured panel divisions, not a dense spiderweb of lines. Mechanical panel details should concentrate around the lower body, side arms and feet.
CRITICAL blank face: leave the upper middle facial region as smooth uninterrupted light gray curved material so two large eyes can be overlaid later. Absolutely NO eyes, eye ovals, eye highlights, black dots, eye sockets, eye openings, visor, facial display, mouth, nose or printed facial features. No circular reactor or decorative screen on its torso.
Arms and feet stay relaxed and baked into this one static image. Do not add articulated fingers, weapons, horns, shoulder spikes, antennas, wings, helmets, clothing, wearable armor accessories, hats, glasses, props, logos, text or extra objects. Cute and approachable, not aggressive.
Preserve the reference silhouette and its transparent alpha beyond the character. Genuinely transparent background, clean edges, no floor, no cast shadow outside the body, no background glow or halo.
